name: Friendship Ended
aka: Friendship Ended With X, Now Y Is My Best Friend
look: A photo of two young men clasping hands in front of a curtain. Colorful gradient text across it announces that a friendship has ended and names a new best friend. In both bottom corners, small photos of another young man in a red shirt are crossed out with green X marks.
use: Announces dumping one thing for another. Fill in the old thing you have given up on and the new favorite that replaced it, often swapping the crossed-out photos and the handshake for pictures of those things.
slots: the old thing you're done with (after 'Friendship ended with', top)
the new favorite (after 'Now', beside the handshake)
describe: two guys shaking hands with an old friend crossed out in the corners
rainbow text saying friendship ended now he is my best friend
men clasping hands with green x over pictures of another guy
colorful edited photo announcing a new best friend
crossed out former friend and new best friend handshake

variants.name: Friendship ended with X, now Y is my best friend
